pois.label: 托卡马克本体（生物屏蔽 Ø16.99 m × 11.51 m，剖切露径向建造）
pois.label_en: Tokamak body (bio-shield dia 16.99 m x 11.51 m, cutaway showing the radial build)
pois.detail: 紧凑型托卡马克本体，按 tokamak 设计册 2026-09-05 声明几何重建：等离子体 R0 = 3.82 m、a = 1.42 m（A = 2.7）、κ = 1.8；外板首壁 5.29 m（R0 + a + 刮削层 0.05）；径向建造自首壁向外为 钨 0.005 | 钢 0.020 | LiPb 增殖层 1.0 | WC-B4C 屏蔽 0.12 | 真空室 0.30 | 真空隙 0.15 | TF 绕组 0.65 | 恒温器隙 0.60 | 恒温器钢壁 0.06 ⇒ 恒温器外面 Ø16.39 m；外包 0.30 m 硼化混凝土生物屏蔽 ⇒ Ø16.99 m；总高 11.51 m（全部径向层竖直包覆；若仅 TF 外层竖直包覆则 7.02 m——竖直建造未定，卡上并印，模型按 11.51 建）。正面 60° 剖切把这一层层建造露出来，粉色为等离子体。9 个赤道窗口中 7 个可见，2 个落在剖切扇区内不画。【已撤】本卡旧值 Ø14.3 m × 15 m 是早期 Blender 外形；2026-09-03 注里的 Ø9.07 m 是中子学一维圆柱模型半径 ×2，不是机器半径；2026-09-05 的 Ø17.15 m（恒温器 Ø16.55 m）用了一维模型自己的 0.13 m 首壁间隙，设计的刮削层是 0.05 m，2026-09-18 改正——均已作废。
pois.detail_en: Compact tokamak body, rebuilt 2026-09-05 to the geometry declared in the tokamak dossier: plasma R0 = 3.82 m, a = 1.42 m (A = 2.7), kappa = 1.8; outboard first wall at 5.29 m (R0 + a + 0.05 scrape-off gap); radial build outward from the first wall: W 0.005 | steel 0.020 | LiPb breeder 1.0 | WC-B4C shield 0.12 | vacuum vessel 0.30 | vacuum gap 0.15 | TF winding 0.65 | cryostat gap 0.60 | cryostat wall 0.06 => cryostat dia 16.39 m; wrapped in 0.30 m of borated concrete => dia 16.99 m; total height 11.51 m (all layers wrapping vertically; 7.02 m if only the layers outside the TF wrap - vertical build undecided, both printed, modelled at 11.51). A 60-degree front cutaway exposes the build layer by layer; pink is the plasma. 7 of the 9 equatorial ports are shown, 2 fall inside the cut sector. [Retired] The card's old 14.3 m x 15 m was an early Blender outline; the 9.07 m in the 2026-09-03 note was the 1-D cylinder-model radius x2, not the machine radius; the 17.15 m (cryostat 16.55 m) of 2026-09-05 used the 1-D model's own 0.13 m first-wall gap where the design scrape-off gap is 0.05 m, corrected 2026-09-18 - all retired.

specs.机器包络: 生物屏蔽外 Ø16.99 m × 11.51 m（恒温器 Ø16.39 m）
specs.等离子体: R0 3.82 m · a 1.42 m · κ 1.8 · A 2.7（tokamak_0d.py）
specs.赤道窗口: 9 个（7 个可见，2 个在剖切扇区内），栓接法兰

specs_en.Machine envelope: bio-shield outer dia 16.99 m x 11.51 m (cryostat dia 16.39 m)
specs_en.Plasma: R0 3.82 m, a 1.42 m, kappa 1.8, A 2.7 (tokamak_0d.py)
specs_en.Radial build (first wall outward): W 0.005 / steel 0.020 / LiPb 1.0 / WC-B4C 0.12 / VV 0.30 / gap 0.15 / TF 0.10+0.55 / gap 0.60 / cryostat 0.06 m (Geant4 stage-1 LAYER table)
specs_en.Biological shield: borated concrete 0.30 m (97% concrete + 3% B4C, rho 2.35) - construction thickness declared 2026-09-02
specs_en.Equatorial ports: 9 (7 shown, 2 inside the cut sector), bolted flanges

sim: 中子泄漏源项（tokamak/neutronics/SOURCE_TERM_DELIVERY.md，Geant4 11.2 分段面源链 + 探针）：恒温器外 t = 0 面逃逸份额 T = 1.639e-7；0.30 m 硼化混凝土外 T = 1.164e-10（284 条记录）≤ 登记目标 1.92e-10——RESOLVED at t = 0.30 m；所需厚度按实测点插值 0.282 m，建造声明取实测面 0.30 m（富余 1.65×）。
分段链的每接缝再表示偏差 b ≈ +4.9%/缝（WC-B4C 与混凝土一致），方向为把 T 报高；按裁定未应用（应用会使屏蔽看起来更好）。
围界哨兵（mars_rad_sic）按此屏蔽重算：58 m 处中子通量 62.5 n·cm⁻²·s⁻¹、柱底座 2.32 cps；大耀斑 F=10⁴ 时中子道读成 ×4.8（旧自设 2 m 屏蔽口径为 ×112，已作废）。

v5 运行点更新（2026-08，第 14–18 轮预测输运）：官方运行点由 848 MW 改为 640 MW——837 MW 热 / 335 MWe 毛 / 502 MW 废热，厂界净电 48 MWe（再循环 267 MWe）。硬件一件未改，改的是运行点口径；壁负荷 2.35→1.77 MW/m²、氚启动库存 1.73→1.31 kg。出处 tokamak/sysdesign/v5_operating_point.json
火星优势：环境气压 0.6 kPa，恒温器外表面对流漏热比地面装置低两个量级，低温系统冷负荷以辐射与支撑导热为主
sim_en: Neutron leakage source term (tokamak/neutronics/SOURCE_TERM_DELIVERY.md, Geant4 11.2 segmented surface-source chain + probes): escape fraction T = 1.639e-7 at the t = 0 face outside the cryostat; T = 1.164e-10 (284 records) outside 0.30 m of borated concrete, below the registered target 1.92e-10 - RESOLVED at t = 0.30 m; required thickness by interpolation between measured points 0.282 m, construction declared at the measured face 0.30 m (margin 1.65x).

Measured attenuation (per slab metre): probes at 0.10/0.20/0.30/0.40 m give cumulative 8.69 / 9.93 / 10.50 / 11.06 decades/m; increments 11.17 / 11.63 / 12.77 - rising with depth (slowing-down into the absorber), the spectrum still evolving over 0-0.40 m.
Per-joint re-representation bias of the segmented chain b ~ +4.9%/joint (WC-B4C and concrete agree), direction over-reports T; not applied by ruling (applying it would make the shield look better).

Perimeter sentinel (mars_rad_sic) recomputed for this shield: 62.5 n/cm2/s at 58 m, pedestal 2.32 cps; a large flare F=1e4 reads x4.8 on the neutron channel (x112 under the old self-set 2 m shield, retired).

v5 operating-point update (2026-08, rounds 14-18): the official point moved from 848 MW to 640 MW - 837 MW thermal / 335 MWe gross / 502 MW rejected, 48 MWe net at the fence (267 MWe recirculated). No hardware changed; wall load 2.35 -> 1.77 MW/m2, tritium startup 1.73 -> 1.31 kg. Source: tokamak/sysdesign/v5_operating_point.json
Martian advantage: at 0.6 kPa the convective heat leak through the cryostat skin is two orders below an Earth plant; the cryogenic load is radiation and support conduction.
physics: 为什么 0.30 m 就够：进入混凝土的中子谱已经很软（中位能 2.7 keV，>0.1 MeV 仅 11%），在含氢混凝土里十几厘米内热化，2.35 wt% 硼把热/超热群吃掉；实测 ~10.6 十倍/米（板厚）。这是软谱 + 重硼的组合，不是快谱去除的 2.5–6 十倍/米。
为什么剖切露出层栈：核心机理不做黑盒——每一层的厚度就是中子学链里用的数，模型即出处。
厚度不覆盖的项：z 端泄漏（直筒化赝像）、孔道流、groundshine——另册。
physics_en: Why 0.30 m suffices: the spectrum entering the concrete is already soft (median 2.7 keV, only 11% above 0.1 MeV); it thermalises within ~10 cm in hydrogenous concrete and 2.35 wt% boron removes the thermal/epithermal groups; measured ~10.6 decades per slab metre. Soft spectrum plus heavy boron - not the 2.5-6 decades/m of fast-spectrum removal.
Why the cutaway: the core is not a black box - every layer thickness is the number used in the neutronics chain; the model is its own provenance.
Not covered by any thickness: end leakage (the straight-cylinder artefact), duct streaming, groundshine - separate accounts.

pois.label: 低温储罐（液氦/液氢）
pois.detail: 两只卧式真空绝热储罐：液氦供 TF/PF 超导线圈 4.5 K 冷质，液氢作预冷级与应急冷备。罐体白色高反照率涂层压低昼间太阳吸热。
pois.detail_en: Two horizontal vacuum-insulated tanks: liquid helium supplies the 4.5 K cold mass of the TF/PF superconducting coils, while liquid hydrogen serves as a pre-cool stage and emergency reserve. A white high-albedo coating suppresses daytime solar pickup.

pois.label: 低温压缩机撬块
pois.detail: 氦制冷循环的室温压缩端：螺杆压缩机 + 油分离 + 两只立式缓冲罐。撬装化设计——整块橇座从地球整体运抵、吊装就位即接管路，火星现场不做精密装配。
pois.detail_en: The room-temperature compression end of the helium refrigeration loop: a screw compressor, oil separation and two vertical buffer tanks. Built as a skid - the whole base ships from Earth as one piece and is craned into place, so no precision assembly is done on Mars.

pois.label: LHCD 射频加热·电流驱动模块
pois.detail: 低杂波电流驱动（LHCD）：速调管阵列产生 GHz 级微波，经波导馈入等离子体驱动非感应电流，维持稳态运行——托卡马克摆脱变压器伏秒限制的关键。两座白色射频厅分列本体东、南，波导直连赤道窗口。
pois.detail_en: Lower-hybrid current drive (LHCD): a klystron array generates GHz microwaves that are fed through waveguides into the plasma to drive non-inductive current, sustaining steady-state operation - the key to freeing a tokamak from the transformer's volt-second limit. Two white RF halls sit east and south of the body, their waveguides running straight to the equatorial ports.

specs.用途: 加热 + 非感应电流驱动

pois.label: 换热器（sCO₂ 一回路）
pois.detail: 包层热量经一回路提取后在此换入超临界 CO₂ 动力循环。sCO₂ 布雷顿循环透平机组体积仅为同功率蒸汽轮机的 1/10 量级，且工质可直接取自火星大气（95% CO₂）——补给零成本。
pois.detail_en: Heat pulled from the blanket by the primary loop is transferred here into a supercritical-CO2 power cycle. An sCO2 Brayton turboset is roughly one-tenth the volume of a steam turbine of equal power, and the working fluid can be drawn straight from the Martian atmosphere (95% CO2) - zero resupply cost.

pois.label: 发电机厅（v5：335 MWe 毛功率·发电机端母线）
pois.label_en: Generator hall (v5: 335 MWe gross, at the generator busbar)
pois.detail: sCO₂ 透平-发电机组厅：毛功率 390 MWe，扣除线圈低温站、加热系统与厂用电后净供电并入城网。夜班窗灯与檐口橙色光带是城东夜景的地标之一。
pois.detail_en: The sCO2 turbine-generator hall: 390 MWe gross, with net power to the city grid after the coil cryoplant, heating systems and station auxiliaries are subtracted. Its night-shift windows and the amber eave strip are a landmark of the eastern skyline after dark.
sim: 母线口径说明（pwr-grid-01 台账）：390 MWe 是发电机端毛功率；LHCD 电流驱动壁插 208 MWe + 厂用 6.5 MWe 回吃后，厂界净出力 176 MWe（Q_e=1.82）。两个数不矛盾——同一台机器在两条母线上的读数。
sim_en: Busbar note (pwr-grid-01 ledger): 390 MWe is gross at the generator busbar; after 208 MWe of wall-plug LHCD current drive and 6.5 MWe of house load, net at the plant fence is 176 MWe (Q_e = 1.82). The two figures never disagreed - they are the same machine read at two busbars.

pois.label: 控制舱
pois.detail: 常态无人值守的本地控制节点：等离子体控制、失超保护与快速停堆逻辑就地闭环（毫秒级不容通信延迟），运行监视远程接入城内计算中心。
pois.detail_en: A normally unmanned local control node: plasma control, quench protection and fast-shutdown logic all close their loops on site (millisecond timing tolerates no comms latency), while operational monitoring links remotely to the city compute center.

specs.中子产额信号(给哨兵网的归一化量): S_rel = S_n/S_n(640 MW);生物屏蔽内面中平面、环向三处 × 两深度(盲管预埋),该处通量约 8.6e+06 n/cm²/s、谱以超热为主;每 1 s 一条、数据龄 1.5 s;有效范围 0.098%–150% 额定;带有效性标志(跟不上/低于下限/降级/标定中)。**设计,未建**——出处 tokamak sysdesign/neutron_yield_diag_report.md(2026-09-19)

specs_en.Neutron-yield signal (normaliser for the: S_rel = S_n/S_n(640 MW); bio-shield inner face at the mid-plane, 3 toroidal positions x 2 depths (blind tubes), flux there about 8.6e+06 n/cm2/s, epithermal spectrum; one sample per 1 s, data age 1.5 s; valid 0.098%-150% of nominal; carries a validity flag (slewing / below floor / degraded / calibrating). DESIGN, NOT BUILT - source: tokamak sysdesign/neutron_yield_diag_report.md (2026-09-19)

pois.label: 辅助散热排（平台）
pois.detail: 平台自带的 12 组 V 形散热板：承担低温站压缩机、射频源与厂用设备的低品位废热（~10 MW 级），与北带 585 MW 主散热阵分级——小热源就地排掉，不占主阵管程。
pois.detail_en: The platform's own 12 V-shaped radiator banks handle the low-grade waste heat of the cryoplant compressors, RF sources and station equipment (~10 MW class), staged apart from the 585 MW main field to the north - small heat sources are dumped locally rather than routed through the main array.
sim: 分级排热理由：主阵工作在 600 K 高温回路，低品位热若并入主阵需先热泵升温，得不偿失；就地 V 形板在 ~350 K 直排即可
sim_en: Why stage the heat rejection: the main field runs a 600 K high-temperature loop, so low-grade heat would have to be pumped up first to join it - not worth it; the local V-panels reject directly at ~350 K.
